gloss: one act (of a play); a scene, an episode

definitions.explanation: A single act of a play, opera or kabuki performance, from the curtain's rise to its fall.
A notable moment in some event, as if it were a scene in a play. Common in news reports: 〜する{一幕|ひとまく}もあった (there was also a moment when …).

examples.japanese: {一幕|ひとまく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧。
examples.english: A short play of only one act.

examples.japanese: {一幕|ひとまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わって⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧になった。
examples.english: The act ended and there was an intermission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌舞伎座|かぶきざ}→歌舞伎座：31161_kabukiza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一幕|ひとまく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At the Kabukiza there are also seats for watching just one act.

examples.japanese: ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一幕|ひとまく}。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{言|い}い{合|あ}う→言い合う：21474_iiau⟧{一幕|ひとまく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At the meeting there was also a moment of heated argument.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦グラウンド→グラウンド：10813_guraundo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧しまう{一幕|ひとまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Midway through the game there was a scene in which a spectator ran onto the field.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{一幕|ひとまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧: there was a moment when …
- {一幕物|ひとまくもの}: a one-act play

WATCH OUT:
- Numbered acts use いち: {第一幕|だいいちまく} (Act One), {第二幕|だいにまく} (Act Two). {一幕|ひとまく} is "one act" or "a scene".
